entities.summary: Barak Hiram is an IDF officer with the rank of Brigadier general, currently serving as the commander of the Gaza Division. Previously, he served as the commander of the 99th Infantry Division, the Golani Brigade, the commander of the live-fire training center in the IDF, the commander of the Golani Brigade, the commander of Golani's training base, and the commander of Battalion 51.
